review_candidates.description: Department: Engineering Location: Arlington, VA Compensation: $90,000 - $184,000 / year Description About The Role: Innovative Defense Technologies (IDT), a leading defense technology company, is seeking a Cyber Security Development Engineer to be part of our Advanced Capabilities team and based out of our Arlington, VA location. The Cyber Security Development Engineer is a highly technical role focused on ensuring the security and resilience of our software and systems and will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining secure systems, applications, and infrastructure to protect against cyber threats. This role blends software development expertise with deep understanding of cybersecurity principles to design, develop, and implement secure solutions for mission-critical environments. Clearance & Location Requirements: All applicants must be able to obtain/maintain an active Secret U.S. Security Clearance. This is a fully on-site position, based out of our Arlington, VA location. Key Responsibilities What You Will Do: Design, develop, and implement security controls and features within software applications and systems. Conduct security assessments, vulnerability scanning, and penetration testing of software and infrastructure. Develop and automate security tools and processes to enhance the software development lifecycle. Respond to and investigate security incidents, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions. Design, implement, and train machine learning models for anomaly detection, behavioral analysis, and proactive threat hunting. Collaborate with development teams to integrate security best practices (DevSecOps) into the entire software development process. Analyze and fortify systems against security threats, ensuring compliance with DoD security standards and requirements. Design, implement, and train machine learning models for anomaly detection, behavioral analysis, and proactive threat hunting. Stay current with the latest cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies to continuously improve the security posture of IDT's solutions. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise Who You Are (Required): Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or other STEM field (or equivalent full-time professional experience) 3 years of experience in the design, development, and management of complex software systems for the DoD. Security+, CCNA, or equivalent IAT Level II certification Ability to travel up to 10% of the time as needed Strong proficiency in programming languages such as, C++, Java, or Python. Advanced knowledge of firewalls, Linux, databases, operating system security, cloud infrastructure, and secure coding practices Expertise with security principles such as encryption, authentication, identity management (SSO, MFA, PAM), and secure API design Knowledge of common security vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10) and how to prevent them. Basic understanding of artificial intelligence and machine learning principles and their application in cybersecurity. Hands-on experience with security testing and assessment tools (e.g., Nessus, Nmap, Wireshark, Splunk, SCAP, Burp Suite, Metasploit). Understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps practices. What Makes You Stand Out: Master's Degree in a relevant field. Relevant cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, CSSLP, CEH, Security+). Experience securing containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes). Experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn). Familiarity with AI security and threat landscapes, such as the MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for AI Systems) framework. Experience securing and deploying AI/ML pipelines within DevSecOps or containerized environments. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible). Experience working with DoD security requirements and STIGs (Security Technical Implementation Guides). If you see yourself reflected in this role and are excited about the impact you could make, we encourage you to apply! If you know someone who may be a great fit, please feel free to share this opportunity with your network. Pay Range*: $90,000 - $150,000 or $114,000 - $184,000 This amount may not be reflective of actual compensation that may be earned as pay is dependent on a candidate’s experience, skills, and education. The posted range does not include bonuses, commissions, tips, or other benefits. IDT is often looking to place multiple candidates at various levels. Therefore, more than one pay range has been included, commensurate with experience. Job Benefits Why Work at Innovative Defense Technologies (IDT): IDT is a growing company with a vibrant, entrepreneurial culture. We are headquartered in Arlington, VA with additional offices in Fall River, MA; Mount Laurel, NJ; and San Diego, CA. At each location, our employees work together in a modern, snack-filled, and social office space, designing innovative solutions for our defense industry customers. We offer employees competitive pay and benefits including: Generous benefits package Competitive PTO Paid holidays 401(k) with immediate vesting and matching 9/80 optional schedule (2nd and 4th Friday off every month) Tuition Assistance Reimbursement Program Professional Development Resources Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits Organization-Wide Monthly Tech Connect Events Annual Employee Recognition Awards Regular Social Events and Catered Lunches EEO Statement: IDT is an Equal Opportunity employer.
